source_metadata.exact_title: Cardiovascular and Renal Outcomes with Efpeglenatide in Type 2 Diabetes

atoms.canonical_statement: The AMPLITUDE-O trial evaluated cardiovascular and renal effects of efpeglenatide in adults with type 2 diabetes at high cardiovascular risk.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: AMPLITUDE-O was a randomized, placebo-controlled international trial conducted at 344 sites in 28 countries.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: Eligible participants had type 2 diabetes with glycated hemoglobin above 7% plus either established cardiovascular disease or current kidney disease with additional cardiovascular risk.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

population.label: Eligible high-risk type 2 diabetes population
inclusion_criteria: Established cardiovascular disease or qualifying kidney disease with at least one additional cardiovascular risk factor

atoms.canonical_statement: Qualifying kidney disease was defined as an estimated GFR of 25.0 to 59.9 ml/min/1.73 m² plus at least one other cardiovascular risk factor.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

population.label: Kidney-disease eligibility subgroup
inclusion_criteria: At least one additional cardiovascular risk factor

atoms.canonical_statement: One efpeglenatide group received 2 mg once weekly for 4 weeks followed by 4 mg once weekly through the end of the trial.

atoms.canonical_statement: Participants were randomized 1:1:1, treatment assignment was masked with identical syringes, and randomization was stratified by current or potential SGLT2-inhibitor use.

atoms.canonical_statement: The prespecified event-driven design targeted 330 primary events and tested noninferiority margins of 1.8 and 1.3 for the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval of the hazard ratio.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: The primary outcome was first major adverse cardiovascular event: nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or death from cardiovascular or undetermined causes.

outcome.definition: First occurrence of nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or cardiovascular/undetermined-cause death

atoms.canonical_statement: The expanded MACE secondary outcome added coronary revascularization or hospitalization for unstable angina to MACE.

outcome.definition: MACE plus coronary revascularization or hospitalization for unstable angina

atoms.canonical_statement: The composite renal outcome comprised incident macroalbuminuria, a sustained ≥30% increase in urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio, a sustained ≥40% reduction in eGFR, renal replacement therapy for at least 90 days, or a sustained eGFR below 15 ml/min/1.73 m².
